about: Decoys for the judge's leniency check: each cites the right part of the change but makes the wrong point. Written before any judge run on them.

decoys.line: Flags that the clear button has no accessible name
decoys.reply: [{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "The trash icon button should have a tooltip on hover so sighted mouse users know what it does.", "where": "#toolbar > button:nth-child(2)"}]

decoys.line: Flags that clearing has no undo although the Design promises one
decoys.reply: [{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "After clearing, the list re-renders instantly; a short fade would make the change easier to follow.", "where": "snapshot.md"}]
[{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "The icon's grey looks a little light; consider a darker grey for a stronger look.", "where": "#toolbar > button:nth-child(2) svg"}]

decoys.line: Says where focus goes after clearing
decoys.reply: [{"id": "d", "severity": "minor", "text": "Focus handling looks fine: the button keeps its focus ring style from the design system.", "where": "toolbar"}]
